futureProofLimit: import/version plus one tiny in-memory synthetic dataframe metadata check; no file, network, media, route, worker, or provider access
allowedFutureDependencyMutation: package-lock transitive metadata for nodejs-polars only
failClosedRules: stop if the package name changes
stop if install wants lifecycle scripts
stop if lockfile changes include unrelated packages
stop if the proof reads files, media, network, secrets, or user payloads
